diagram_check.map_direction: Both rows point left-to-right: 0→A→B→C→0 and 0→A′→B′→C′→0. The vertical maps point downward a:A→A′, b:B→B′, and c:C→C′, exactly as declared in Facts & Assumptions.
diagram_check.short_exact_rows: The diagram displays the endpoint zeros and the four horizontal maps i,p,i′,p′ in the source's short exact rows. The row assumptions therefore give i,i′ injective, p,p′ surjective, im(i)=ker(p), and im(i′)=ker(p′).
diagram_check.commutativity: The labels are consistent with the stated squares b∘i=i′∘a and c∘p=p′∘b. The arrow directions make both composites well-typed.
diagram_check.connecting_homomorphism: For z∈ker(c), surjectivity of p gives y∈B with p(y)=z. Commutativity gives p′(b(y))=c(p(y))=0; exactness and injectivity of i′ give a unique x′∈A′ with i′(x′)=b(y). The connecting map is δ(z)=[x′] in coker(a), as stated. Replacing y by y+i(x) changes x′ by a(x), so the class is independent of the lift.
diagram_check.induced_sequence: The stated order is 0→ker(a)→ker(b)→ker(c)→δ coker(a)→coker(b)→coker(c)→0. The kernel maps are induced by i and p; the cokernel maps by i′ and p′. This has the standard endpoints and connecting-map direction for the snake lemma.
